chunks: The chains of transmission for the book Man La Yahḍuruhu al-Faqih have been completed by the praise of Allah and His favor, and blessings be upon Muḥammad and his pure family.

key_terms.أَسَانِيدُ: chains of transmission for hadith reports
key_terms.بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ وَمَنِّهِ: by Allah’s praise and gracious favor
key_terms.مَنْ لَا يَحْضُرُهُ الْفَقِيهُ: the title of the hadith book Man La Yahḍuruhu al-Faqih

ai.seo_question: What does the closing statement at the end of the chains of transmission in Man La Yahḍuruhu al-Faqih say?
ai.summary: This is a closing statement announcing the completion of the transmission chains for the book Man La Yahḍuruhu al-Faqih. It attributes that completion to Allah’s praise and favor and concludes with blessings upon Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and his pure family.
